summary.text: Bob Wittke is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 63 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Robert Wittke earned a B.A. in accounting from the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire, according to Ballotpedia, and is a senior implementation specialist with Corptax Inc.
Ballotpedia says he and his wife have two children.

Wittke was assigned to the Audit Committee as chair, the Joint Legislative Audit Committee as co-chair, and the Financial Institutions and State Affairs committees for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
